description: Needs sign-in: Show the Compute Engine's own step-by-step working for an operation on a LaTeX expression, so you can relay the steps instead of inventing them. operation is one of "simplify", "solve" (latex must be an equation, e.g. "x^2=4"), "D" (differentiate) or "Integrate". With documentId, it sees that document's definitions. Returns { operation, initial, result, steps: [{ latex, description }] }; relay the steps in order, never fabricate them.

documentId.description: The id of a document (from list_documents or search_documents). With it, the expression sees that document's definitions; without it, an empty scope.

latex.description: The expression (or equation, for "solve") to explain, in LaTeX.

operation.description: Which working to trace: "simplify", "solve" (an equation), "D" (a derivative), or "Integrate".

name: explain
title: Explain a computation
